description: This file is a shell script containing tests for Git commands, specifically testing the 'git ls-files --deduplicate' functionality along with other related options. It defines setup procedures, performs commits, tags, resets, and compares output against expected results to validate behavior.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success status from the commands within its block.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting the commands within its block to fail.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of two files to ensure they are identical.
